chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text:
The purpose of this enhancement is to ensure that the FPO Material Allocation screen displays the most recently adjusted equivalent article when multiple inhouse equivalent adjustment transactions are created for the same indent/article.
This will provide accurate and updated equivalent article information to users during material allocation processing.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
Currently, when multiple inhouse equivalent adjustment transactions are created in an indent, the system displays the first equivalent article adjusted in the indent within the FPO Material Allocation screen.
This results in outdated article information being displayed when subsequent equivalent adjustments are performed.
Business requires that:
• The system should display the latest equivalent article adjusted through inhouse equivalent adjustment transactions.
• The latest adjustment should override the previously displayed equivalent article in FPO Material Allocation.
Example:

chunks.title: Proposed Solution
chunks.heading: Proposed Solution
chunks.text:
Modify the equivalent article fetching logic in FPO Material Allocation to retrieve the latest inhouse equivalent adjustment transaction instead of the first transaction.
The system should:
• Fetch all equivalent adjustment transactions for the respective indent/article.
• Identify the latest transaction based on:
• Transaction creation time.
• Display the equivalent article from the latest adjustment transaction in FPO Material Allocation.
• The same details will show in GDI creation screen as well.
